column2: Only the head of my cult is fit to crown me!
Send for the most powerful high priest in the realm!
Write a letter to the most influential and powerful [Root.Religion.GetName] high priest in your realm, asking him to crown you §Y[Root.GetTitle]§! of §Y[Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName]§!.

Write a letter to a minor high priest, asking him to crown you §Y[Root.GetTitle]§! of §Y[Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName]§!. \nThough a less prestigious choice than others, doing so will at least placate your vassals and will be less likely to bankrupt your realm.
I AM THE VOICE OF [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]! I WANT ALL OF IT!

To the Excellent [Root.GetTitledName],
I shall be honored to officiate [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific]'s coronation, provided that [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific] donates a small sum of money to the temple as a show of [Root.GetHerHisCap] devotion.

Ever [Root.GetHerHis] [Root.GetHonorific]'s servant
[From.GetTitledName]

I kneel before [coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName] with all my reverently silent vassals surrounding us. The [coronation_priest.GetTitle] gives me an encouraging smile as [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] blesses me and places the Royal Crown upon my head as I feel my face turn red. [coronation_priest.GetSheHeCap] then proclaims me [coronation_ruler.GetTitle] of [coronation_ruler.PrimaryTitle.GetName] by grace of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName].

I kneel before [coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName] with all my reverently silent vassals surrounding us. The [coronation_priest.GetTitle] gives me an encouraging smile as [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] blesses me and places the Royal Crown upon my head as I feel my face turning red. [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] then proclaims me [coronation_ruler.GetTitle] of [coronation_ruler.PrimaryTitle.GetName] by grace of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName].

The time has finally come for me to be officially recognized as [Root.GetTitle] of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. In order do this, I will need the support of the [Root.Religion.GetName] cult, but convincing authoritative members will neither be easy nor cheap. To begin the preparations, I should find a priest willing to crown me.
Any priest will do.
Maybe this is not the right time...
[From.GetFullName] wishes me to crown [From.GetHerHim] [From.GetTitle] of [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. What do I wish to ask [From.GetHerHim] in return?
Little to nothing.
A reasonable request.

To the Excellent [Root.GetTitledName],
I shall be honored to officiate [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific]'s coronation. I eagerly await [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific]'s instructions regarding date and manner of the ceremony in order to better prepare myself for this sacred duty.

Ever [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific]'s servant
[From.GetTitledName]
Marvelous.
Understandable.
I have no money to spare!

To the Excellent [Root.GetTitledName],
I shall be honored to officiate [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific]'s coronation, provided that [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific] donates a sizable sum of money to the temple of [From.Capital.GetName] as a show of [Root.GetHerHisCap] devotion.

Ever [Root.GetHerHis] [Root.GetHonorific]'s servant
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well.
I have no such money to spare.

To the Excellent [Root.GetTitledName],
I shall be honored to officiate [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific]'s coronation, provided that [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific] donates a sizable sum of money to the [From.Religion.GetName] cult as a show of [Root.GetHerHisCap] devotion.

Ever [Root.GetHerHis] [Root.GetHonorific]'s servant
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well.
I have no such money to spare.

To the Excellent [Root.GetTitledName],
I shall be honored to officiate [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific]'s coronation, provided that [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific] show [Root.GetHerHisCap] devotion by allowing the temple to initiate one of [Root.GetHerHisCap] children to the cloistered life of a temple novice.

Ever [Root.GetHerHis] [Root.GetHonorific]'s servant
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well.
No child of mine will waste his life in a temple cloister!

To the Excellent [Root.GetTitledName],
I shall be honored to officiate [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific]'s coronation, provided that [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific] show [Root.GetHerHisCap] devotion by allowing one of [Root.GetHerHisCap] sons to do his part in the sacred war against the infidels by joining one of our templar orders.

Ever [Root.GetHerHis] [Root.GetHonorific]'s servant
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well.
I will not risk my son's life for a crown.

To the Excellent [Root.GetTitledName],
I shall be honored to officiate [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific]'s coronation, provided that [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific] show [Root.GetHerHisCap] devotion by organizing a private feast in honor of an ardent servant of the temple such as I am.

Ever [Root.GetHerHis] [Root.GetHonorific]'s servant
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well.
I will not be part of whatever debauchery [From.GetSheHe] has in mind!

To the Excellent [Root.GetTitledName],
I shall be honored to officiate [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific]'s coronation, provided that [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific] show [Root.GetHerHisCap] devotion by expanding the borders of the temple lands of [From.Capital.GetName].

Ever [Root.GetHerHis] [Root.GetHonorific]'s servant
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well.
[From.GetSheHeCap] has enough land as it is.

To the Excellent [Root.GetTitledName],
I shall be honored to officiate [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific]'s coronation, provided that [Root.GetHerHisCap] [Root.GetHonorific] show [Root.GetHerHisCap] devotion by joining me as a pious member of the [From.Society.GetName].

Ever [Root.GetHerHis] [Root.GetHonorific]'s servant
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well.
I will not be part of your Order.

To [Root.GetTitledName],
I shall be glad to recognize your divine right to rule, as soon as you donate what is due to the temple. 

Sincerely,
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well.
This is too much for me.

To [Root.GetTitledName],
I will gladly recognize your divine right to rule, as soon as you prove your devotion to the [From.Religion.GetName] by donating land to one of the templar orders who so fervently defend Our temple against all the infidels and sinners who would wish it destroyed. 

Sincerely,
[From.GetTitledName]
The templar knights will have their lands.
I do not wish to give away pieces of my realm for a crown.

With the false pretender forced to abandon his unholy grab for the high seat of the cult, and with full dignity restored to the temple, the rightful head of the faith has finally agreed to crown me [Root.GetTitle]. It is time to sheathe our weapons and let the celebrations begin.
Finally...

I have wrested the temple lands from the heathens and delivered them back into the keeping of the faithful. Such a deed has surely earned me the favour of the gods, or at the very least the gratitude of the head of my faith.
I have wrested the temple lands from the heathens and delivered them back into the keeping of the faithful. Now that this war is over, it is finally time for me to receive my crown.
Excellent.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has died: with [From.GetHerHim] gone I must find another priest to anoint me [Root.GetTitle].
How unfortunate.
Now that I have a distinguished member of the [Root.Religion.GetName] clergy to officiate my coronation, I must decide how much I wish to spend on the ceremony leading up to it.
It shall be an extravagant ceremony.
A dignified ceremony will do.
I will have a private ceremony.

My dear [Root.GetTitledFirstName],
I wish to formally invite you to my court for a period of festivities leading up to my coronation.

Sincerely,
[From.GetTitledName]
I will be sure to attend.
I must decline this honor.

Distinguished [Root.GetTitledFirstName],
I wish to formally invite you to my court for a period of festivities leading up to my coronation.

Sincerely,
[From.GetTitledName]
I will be sure to attend.
I must decline.
[Root.GetTitledFirstName],\nI will be glad to attend your coronation!
Very good.
[Root.GetTitledFirstName],\nI am afraid I have to decline your invitation.
What a pity.

The time of my coronation draws near: only a few more days before I am crowned [Root.GetTitle] before [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] and all my subjects. My court has been already filled with all the vassals of my realm who have come to bear witness to this fundamental moment of my reign.

The time of my coronation draws near: only a few more days before I am crowned [Root.GetTitle] before [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] and all my subjects. It will be a long wait with very little to do, but I hope at least that this period of seclusion will give me time to ponder upon my future responsibilities as [Root.GetTitle].
It will never be soon enough.
Could we be friends?
And yet, maybe I should keep my distance from [potential_friend.GetHerHim].

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has spared no expenses for [From.GetHerHis] coronation. As I was admiring the lavish sights offered by [From.GetHerHis] palace, I was approached by the [From.GetTitle] [From.GetHerselfHimself]. After having talked to [From.GetHerHim] for a while, I am starting to think we might have a lot in common...
Let us join our realms in friendship!
will receive your request of friendship.
And yet, maybe I should keep my distance from [potential_friend.GetHerHim].

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has cheerfully accepted my offer of friendship. I was not wrong putting my trust in [From.GetHerHim], and now, thanks to this fortuitous meeting, we have both ensured a lasting peace between our two realms.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has cheerfully accepted my offer for friendship. I was not wrong in putting my trust in [From.GetHerHim], and now, thanks to this fortuitous meeting, I have further guaranteed the stability of my realm.
Excellent.

Unfortunately, [From.GetTitledFirstName] did not seem to share my feelings and politely refused my offer of friendship. While [From.GetSheHe] was hardly rude or confrontational, it is unfortunate that we could not see eye to eye.
Maybe [From.GetSheHe] will change [From.GetHerHis] mind in the future...

Organizing such a great ceremony has given me the chance to know better some of my vassals. Maintaining healthy relationships with all my subjects is fundamental to ensure the future stability and prosperity of my realm. [potential_friend.GetTitledFirstName] in particular seems like a [potential_friend.GetManWoman] I could really trust...
Could we be friends?
And yet, maybe I should keep my distance from [potential_friend.GetHerHim].

Meeting new rulers and exchanging ideas about politics and royal virtues has been an interesting consequence of this ceremony. Everybody has at least one anecdote to share with me about the proper way to rule a Kingdom. I wonder which is closer to the truth...
Fostering good relations with one's neighbors and subjects is paramount.
Proper handling of the realm's finances is fundamental.

During the evening, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has remarked on multiple occasions of how it is important for a new ruler to create stable diplomatic relationships with [From.GetHerHis] peers and subjects in order to ensure peace and prosperity for everyone. [From.GetHerHisCap] show of dialectics has been a revelation for all the guests.
I might even learn something from [From.GetHerHis] example.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has entertained [From.GetHerHis] guests during the evening with a remarkable show of knowledge in the matters of State. While tedious to a few of the guests, some of the ideas we all discussed about how to improve and solidify a realm's economy were quite inspirational.
I wonder if I could apply them on my own holdings...

[coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName]'s presence for my upcoming coronation has lured an entire flock of scholars and theologians in my court. While most of them keep their distance from the nobility, I have had the chance to overhear a few of them discussing about the most intriguing, metaphysical subjects during the evening.
I will keep listening to them in the shadows.
I will join the conversation.
...I might be learning something useful tonight.

With so many distinguished guests having traveled all the way to my court, the least I could do is entertain them while we all wait for the day of my coronation. This could also provide me with an opportunity to impress some of my more influential guests.
Having all the important grownups in my palace is great opportunity to show them that I am just as smart and wise as any [Root.GetTitle] no matter how old I am.
Hear me, everyone!
Attempt to use §YDiplomacy§! to impress your guests.
I do not want to embarrass myself before the ceremony.

Whatever doubts I might have had about my performance were completely unfounded: my speech about the duties of a good [Root.GetTitle] to [Root.GetHerHis] subjects was poignant and extremely well received.
When I started I was shaking a bit, but, after I finished listing all the responsibilities my tutor taught me about being a good [Root.GetTitle], all my guests applauded and congratulated me.
Phew...
All of the guests' opinion is increased by §G+10§! because of your speech.

Despite my best efforts, my speech about the duties of a good [Root.GetTitle] to [Root.GetHerHis] subjects was received a bit too coldly compared to my expectations. Perhaps I should have used less platitudes and talked about something more substantive...

Just while I was in the middle of listing the duties of a good [Root.GetTitle] like my tutor taught me, somebody in the crowd coughed and I lost my concentration! After a few failed attempts at resuming my speech, I was too embarrassed to continue and left the room covering my face.
Ugh, this could have gone better.
All of the guests' opinion is lowered by §R-10§! because of your speech.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] decided to call for the attention of all [From.GetHerHis] guests before tonight's dinner and spent a great deal of time decanting the virtues of a good [From.GetTitle]. [From.GetHerHisCap] speech was passionate and on point, enough to convince many of the people present that [From.GetSheHe] will be an extraordinary ruler.

The young [From.GetTitledFirstName] decided to call for the attention of all [From.GetHerHis] guests before tonight's dinner and spent a great deal of time listing the virtues of a good [From.GetTitle]. It was quite surprising to see a child show already such wisdom, so much so that, after [From.GetHerHis] speech, many were convinced that, despite [From.GetHerHis] young age, [From.GetFirstName] might make a great [From.GetTitle].
Myself included.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] decided to call for the attention of all [From.GetHerHis] guests before tonight's dinner and spent a great deal of time decanting the virtues of a good [From.GetTitle]. Sadly, [From.GetHerHis] speech was stale and filled with platitudes, and not many believed in the conviction that [From.GetSheHe] proclaimed to have.

The young [From.GetTitledFirstName] decided to call for the attention of all [From.GetHerHis] guests before tonight's dinner and spent a great deal of time listing the virtues of a good [From.GetTitle]. Unfortunately, the child was not up to the task and stopped midway through [From.GetHerHis] speech, rushing away, red with embarrassment.
What a shame.

I can almost feel the weight of the crown over my head already, but it is far from burdensome: I feel reinvigorated by the prospect of finally becoming [Root.GetTitle]. Thinking about my new responsibilities as an anointed ruler fills me with trepidation.
I shall be the greatest [Root.GetTitle] ever!
This is a sign to stop slouching and take my work seriously.

With all this pomp and circumstance, all these lavish preparations, and with my coronation so close, I am finally starting to understand the weight and importance of my role as [Root.GetTitle]. People expect great things of me.
And I will not disappoint them.
Yet I should not let pride blind me.

Everybody is so kind and respectful to me, even a lot of important people that I only met a few days ago. This Coronation Ceremony is a lot more important than I had thought. It is really great to be a [Root.GetTitle]!
I am the most important person EVER!
I should work hard to show that I know how important this is.

[coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName] approached me tonight to personally inform me of how satisfied [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] is with the great month of festivity I have organized to accompany my coronation. [coronation_priest.GetSheHeCap] wanted to be sure that I knew of how welcome [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] feels at my court, and that [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] expects great things of me.
I am flattered.

[coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName] approached [From.GetTitledFirstName] tonight to personally inform [From.GetHerHim] of how satisfied [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] is of the great month of festivity [From.GetSheHe] has organized to accompany [From.GetHerHis] coronation. [coronation_priest.GetFirstName] wanted to be sure that [From.GetTitledFirstName], as well as everyone within earshot, knew of how welcome [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] feels at [From.GetHerHis] court, and that [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] expects great things of [From.GetHerHim].
It surely is an impressive ceremony...

[coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName] took me aside after dinner for a long talk about the duties I take up once [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] crowns me Emperor. [coronation_priest.GetSheHeCap] warned me that to sit the throne of Sigmar Heldenhammer, to carry the burden of Ghal Maraz and to stand as the shield of all mankind against the Ruinous Powers is a colossal undertaking, and that I must strive every day to be worthy of it.
I will bring new glory to the Empire.
Tell me more about Sigmar and the Emperors of old...
I will work tirelessly to be a worthy heir to the Heldenhammer.

Late this evening, as the servants were clearing up our tables, [coronation_priest.GetTitledName] decided to talk to me about my new responsibilities after the coronation: as a [Root.Religion.GetName] [Root.GetTitle], I will be sworn to care for the secular needs of all my subjects as well as to stand against the tide of sin and heresy beseeching our world.
The world will never know a more devout [Root.GetTitle] than me.
Let us talk about the details of these responsibilities...
Empty words and nothing more.

I can only imagine what pressure [From.GetTitledFirstName] must be under, to be given the responsibility of an entire realm while so young must be overwhelming. Perhaps I should take some time aside before dinner and try to teach [From.GetHerHim] a few things about being a good [Root.GetTitle], and thus repay the kindness [From.GetSheHe] did me by inviting me to such a lavish celebration.
Your [From.GetHonorific], could you lend me your ear for a moment?
I am sure [From.GetSheHe] will be able to handle it.

I was just preparing myself for dinner, when [From.GetTitledFirstName], one of my foreign guests, decided to take me aside, offering to teach me a few things that a good [Root.GetTitle] should know in order to rule wisely.
I want to know! Tell me!
You are not my tutor, we are equal!

[From.GetTitledFirstName] was happy to learn more about [From.GetHerHis] upcoming responsibilities as a [From.GetTitle] from me. I am sure that what I told [From.GetHerHim] tonight will be of great use to [From.GetHerHim] in the future, and it will make [From.GetHerHis] realm more prosperous as well.
A good action is its own reward.

Perhaps [From.GetTitledFirstName] is too young to understand that I was only attempting to aid [From.GetHerHim]: [From.GetSheHe] did not listen to my words and dismissed [From.GetHerselfHimself] as soon as [From.GetSheHe] could. This sacred ceremony might well be just a big game for [From.GetHerHim].
Such is the foolishness of youth.

I was surprised tonight when [coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName] stated that the period of festivity I have organized is unfit for the severity of the holy charge I am about to receive. [coronation_priest.GetSheHeCap] has concluded [coronation_priest.GetHerHis] scolding by remarking that [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] has witnessed many impious acts and degenerate behavior during [coronation_priest.GetHerHis] visit that have left [coronation_priest.GetHerHim] shocked and repulsed.
Clearly [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] is exaggerating...

Many tonight were surprised when [coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName] stated that the period of festivity [From.GetTitledFirstName] has organized is unfit for the severity of the holy charge [From.GetSheHe] is about to take. [coronation_priest.GetSheHeCap] has concluded [coronation_priest.GetHerHis] scolding by remarking that [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] has witnessed many impious acts and degenerate behaviors during [coronation_priest.GetHerHis] visit that have left [coronation_priest.GetHerHim] shocked and repulsed.
Our host should be ashamed of [From.GetHerselfHimself].

It was not enough to learn that [From.GetTitledFirstName] was at [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName]'s celebration: tonight, in the middle of dinner, my old rival decided to insult me in front of my host and many of the other guests!

I would be quite enjoying my visit at [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName]'s court if it were not for [From.GetTitledFirstName] constant harassment. The [From.GetManWoman] is clearly jealous of my accomplishments as [Root.GetTitle], and cannot stop trying to besmirch my reputation, hoping it would make [From.GetHerHim] feel better about [From.GetHerselfHimself].
How dare you!

It was not enough to learn that [From.GetTitledFirstName] was at [FromFromFrom.GetTitledFirstName]'s celebration: tonight, in the middle of dinner, my old rival decided to insult me in front of my host and many of the other guests!

I would be quite enjoying my visit at [FromFromFrom.GetTitledFirstName]'s court if it were not for [From.GetTitledFirstName] constant harassment. The [From.GetManWoman] is clearly jealous of my accomplishments as [Root.GetTitle], and cannot stop trying to besmirch my reputation, hoping it would make [From.GetHerHim] feel better about [From.GetHerselfHimself].
How dare you!

A heated argument has sparked between [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] and [From.GetTitledFirstName], two of my distinguished foreign guests. Whatever their reasons, this diplomatic incident could be a stain on the legitimacy of this ceremony if not properly handled.
I am sure I can make them see reason.
Attempt to use §YDiplomacy§! to calm the two rulers.
I better not interfere.

Thanks to my diplomatic skills I was able to not only stop the argument between the two rival rulers from escalating, but to also mend their disagreements permanently. We talked long after the dinner was over and when the two of them retired to their rooms for the night they professed that they have found a new friend in me.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] decided to interfere with the argument I was in. While at first I was doubtful [From.GetSheHe] could offer any help, [From.GetHerHis] intervention was enough not only to stop my rival's unjust accusations, but also to help clear any disagreements we might have had with each other permanently. [From.GetTitledFirstName] has proven [From.GetHerselfHimself] to be a true friend.
Excellent.
Thanks to my diplomatic skills I was able to not only stop the argument between the two rival rulers from escalating, but to also mend their disagreements permanently.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] decided to interfere with the argument I was in. While at first I was doubtful [From.GetSheHe] could offer any help, [From.GetHerHis] intervention was enough not only to stop my rival's unjust accusations, but also to help clear any disagreements we might have had with each other permanently.
Good.
Unfortunately, my attempt to help my two guests calm down were unsuccessful. In the end, I was forced to leave them to their bickering, lest I was dragged in the fight as well.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] decided to interfere in the argument I was in. While [From.GetHerHis] intentions were good, [From.GetHerHis] attempt to mend the disagreements I have with my rival was fruitless. This is no problem that can be fixed with a simple talk.
Shameful.

Unfortunately, my attempt to help my two guests calm down were unsuccessful. Even worse, at the end of the dinner, I had somehow managed to convince both [From.GetTitledFirstName] and [From.GetTitledFirstName] that I was as much an enemy to them as they were to each other.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] decided to interfere in the argument I was in. As if that was not embarrassing enough, I am now certain that [From.GetSheHe] favored my rival's reasons over mine, a clear breach of [From.GetHerHis] duty as host to be welcoming to all [From.GetHerHis] guests.
This is unacceptable!

There [coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName] goes again, scolding [From.GetTitledFirstName]'s guests with another sermon. It has been days now since I have had to put up with [coronation_priest.GetHerHis] endless moralizing, I cannot really take anymore of it.
I will shut [coronation_priest.GetHerHim] up this time!
[coronation_priest.GetSheHeCap] is the [coronation_priest.GetTitle] after all...

My celebrations have been interrupted by a heated argument between [From.GetTitledFirstName] and [coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName] about the nature of devotion. I should probably put a stop to this before things escalate further.

I kneel before [coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName] as a host of Electors and vassals surrounds us in complete silence. The [coronation_priest.GetTitle] blesses me and raises the Crown of Sigmar to place it upon my head and proclaim me [coronation_ruler.GetTitle] of the Empire by grace of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], heir of the Heldenhammer and shield of all mankind.
Let me clear things up for both of you...
[coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName] is clearly right.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] is clearly right.
I better not interfere.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] decided to interfere with my argument with [coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName]. While [From.GetSheHe] forced me to stop from further deriding the [coronation_priest.GetTitle], [From.GetSheHe] was also kind enough to recognize the validity of some of my complaints about [coronation_priest.GetFirstName]'s behavior.
At least [coronation_priest.GetSheHe] stopped preaching...

[From.GetTitledFirstName] decided to interfere with my argument with [coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName], and predictably, the [From.GetTitle]-to-be decided to take the side of the [coronation_priest.GetTitle]. There is no doubt in my mind that [From.GetSheHe] did so only because [From.GetSheHe] does not wish to risk losing the officiant of [From.GetHerHis] coronation.
What a hypocrite.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] decided to interfere with my argument with [coronation_priest.GetTitledFirstName], and surprisingly, the [From.GetTitle]-to-be took my side, going against the [coronation_priest.GetTitle] who is supposed to crown [From.GetHerHim] only a few days from now.
I will not forget your kindness, [From.GetFirstName].

This morning, a curious visitor came to my court: he is a wandering knight who traveled to [Root.Capital.GetName] after hearing news of my upcoming coronation. He has proclaimed that he wishes to pledge his sword to my service. He is ready and eager to serve a [Root.GetTitle] as wise and renown as I am to his death.

This morning a curious visitor came to my court: he is a wandering knight who traveled to [Root.Capital.GetName] after hearing news of my upcoming coronation. He has proclaimed that he wishes to pledge his loyalty to me and protect my honor from all offenders. He is ready and eager to defend the reputation of a [Root.GetTitle] whose virtue is as renown as mine to his death.

This morning a curious visitor came to my court: he is a wandering knight who traveled to [Root.Capital.GetName] after hearing news of my upcoming coronation. He has proclaimed that he wishes to pledge his loyalty to me and protect me from any who would attempt to harm me. He is ready and eager to join the ranks of my bodyguards and shield my life with his.

As if sending an Arch-Lector in [coronation_priest.GetHerHis] place was not slight enough from the head of the cult, the envoy himself has proven a most insufferable man, constantly complaining about the poor care he receives and listing all the dangers I expose him to by holding this coronation in the middle of a war.
You are welcome, [coronation_knight.GetFirstName]!
Begone, I do not know you.

It was hard to notice at first, but, after spending a few days with him in my service, I have come to realize that [coronation_knight.GetFirstName]'s devotion to me goes well beyond the boundaries of loyalty between a knight and his [Root.GetTitle]. Tonight, I pressed the issue with him, only to have [coronation_knight.GetTitledFirstName] kneel at my feet and profess his undying love for me.
Oh, I love you too, [coronation_knight.GetTitledFirstName]!
Can we not just be friends instead?
Unacceptable. You are relieved of duty.
[coronation_knight.GetTitledFirstName] leaves your court forever.
